headline: French prosecutors launch investigations after Marseille and Levski Sofia clashes leave 11 injured
label: NEWS
caption:
French prosecutors have launched formal investigations following violent clashes between football fans that left 11 people injured.

According to Anadolu Ajansı, the clashes broke out during a match involving Marseille and Levski Sofia.

Authorities are now working to determine the full sequence of events and identify those responsible for the violence.
